caption: The drawing features three distinct renderings of an object against a beige background. On the left side, there is a cylindrical object with a light brown color and subtle wood grain patterns. This object has a flat, wide circular base and a tall, narrow cylindrical handle extending vertically from the center of the top surface, which has two concentric circular grooves. On the right side of the drawing, there is a circular, disk-like face shown from above, displaying an intricate carved pattern consisting of stylized leaves, acorns, and branches with a textured border made of short vertical lines. Below these, in the center, is a simple black outline diagram showing a cross-sectional view of the cylindrical object, highlighting how the handle connects to the base. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature reading "Lawrence Flynn." The color palette primarily uses shades of light brown and beige with darker brown detailing for the carved pattern.
title: Butter Mold - Burr Design
